purpose: Registry-only color-purity and perceptual-fidelity layer for scientific-religious video. Inspired by the functional goal of color filtering/purity systems such as NanoCell, but implemented as source-aware digital processing rather than a hardware display filter.
importantDistinction: NanoCell is display hardware technology using nanoparticles to filter impure portions of the RGB spectrum. This registry does not claim to reproduce that physical mechanism; it defines a software/video pipeline for cleaner, more consistent, source-faithful color.

OpenColorIO.role: Color-space management, transforms and display-aware pipeline control.
OpenColorIO.licenseGate: verify exact integrated version/license before production use

ACES.role: Wide-gamut scene-referred color management and mastering/interchange strategy.

BasicSR.role: Image/video restoration toolbox for denoise, deblur and super-resolution.

BasicVSR++.role: Video restoration and video super-resolution with temporal propagation/alignment.

Real-ESRGAN.role: Image restoration/super-resolution candidate for selected frames and assets.
Real-ESRGAN.rightsGate: verify current project and each weight license

colorPurityMeans: recovered detail without hallucinated scientific content
qualityRules.textLayers: Quran, hadith, citations and scientific labels are rendered from source data/vectors at the final output resolution and are never reconstructed by super-resolution.
qualityRules.enhancementBoundary: Enhancement must not invent scientific observations, change source labels, alter Quranic Arabic, alter hadith wording, or create unsupported factual detail.

outputPolicy.masteringStrategy: generate_or_source -> restore -> color_manage -> compose -> validate -> upscale_as_needed -> text_vector_overlay -> display_transform -> final_master
outputPolicy.48KMeaning: 48K is a supported master/render ceiling. The system must distinguish native detail from restored/upscaled detail and report the provenance of the enhancement path.
